answer.reason: Yemen's rural population share has declined steadily as its urban share grew; by 2023 the World Bank lists Yemen's rural population at roughly 61%, not 63%. Option A (~63.43%) corresponds to an earlier year (around 2017-2018), while Option B (61.1808138127209%) matches the World Bank's reported 2023 value for YEM, being the complement of an urban share of about 38.82%.
